maybe try below code:
choosev <- c(0.005,0.005,0.4,0.4,0.0205,0.0205,0.05,0.05)
Var1 <- factor(rep(c("A1","A2"),4))
Var2 <- c("Q1","Q1","Q2","Q2","Q3","Q3","Q4","Q4")
Freq <- c(4,2,6,2,6,4,9,3)
df <- data.frame(Var1,Var2, Freq,choosev)

ggplot(df[df$choosev>=0.05,], aes(x=Var2, y=Freq))+ 
        geom_bar(stat="identity", aes(fill = Var1), position="dodge")+
        geom_bar(stat="identity",data=df[df$choosev<0.05,],aes(x=Var2,y=Freq,fill = Var1),color="black",position="dodge")

aes(fill=object), the object must a variable, not allow "black" or "transparent". If we want to set "black", the [color="black"] must to key in outside.
so we use two dataset. 
1.df[df$choosev>=0.05,]
2.df[df$choosev<0.05,]
